verses.ya-l-lahu-ya-hayyu-ya-qayyumu-ya-l-lahu-: yā llāhu yā ḥayyū yā qayyūmu yā llāhu yā kāshifa ḍ-ḍurri wal-balwāʾi yā llāhu
yā llāhu fājzi biʾaʿlā mā jazayta bihi ʿannā sh-shafīʿa lanā yā llāhu yā llāhu
wajāziyan shaykhanā ʿannā biʾafḍali mā jāzayta shaykhā bihi yā llāhu yā llāhu
shaykha sh-shuyūkhi ʾabā l-ʿabbāsi sayyidanā waman lanā wuṣlahu yā llāhu yā llāhu
kashaykhinā sayyidī l-ghālī wasīlatinā wasayyidī ʿumari yā llāhu yā llāhu
wanajlihi ʾaḥmada l-murdī l-ghuwāti ʾaʿin ʿalā ʿidāhu maʿā yā llāhu yā llāhu
wasayyidī nuṣratī khālī waghayrihimu yā llāhu yā rabbanā yā llāhu yā llāhu
kashaykhinā l-ḥāfiẓi ṣ-ṣāfī shamāʾiluhu wash-shaykhi mawlūdinā yā llāhu yā llāhu
wakālṣṣafiyyī muḥammad ʿāli sayyidinā fārḥam jamāʿatanā yā llāhu yā llāhu
wārḍa biʾakbari riḍwāni mananta bihi ʿani l-jamīʿi riḍā yā llāhu yā llāhu
waʾaqbal lanā kullamā naʾatīka min khidami bijāhihim rabbanā yā llāhu yā llāhu
bijāhihim kuffa ʿannā rabbi wāqiyanā sharra l-ʿudāti lanā yā llāhu yā llāhu
wakun lanā kullamā ʾamri nuḥāwiluhu yā llāhu yā rabbanā yā llāhu yā llāhu
wāghfir lanā rabbanā wal-wālidīna maʿā waman lanā muḥsinu yā llāhu yā llāhu
wakullu man yaqtafī nahja rasūlika yā mawlāyā yā rabbanā yā llāhu yā llāhu
ṣalli ʿalayhi wasallim dāʾimā ʾabadā wal-ʾāli yā rabbanā yā llāhu yā llāhu
